text_en: Tin man... I hope I'm not prying into things I shouldn't, but I know these lands well enough to tell you what you'll find if you continue in that direction.
Then believe when I tell you that, if you decide to head that way alone... Well, let's just say I doubt anyone would be able to find what's left of you.
At least let your own people know where you're off to.
Be sensible and listen to the voice of experience, yes?
